title: Write an OpenAPI 3 JSON contract file
prompt: Write contracts/api.json, an OpenAPI 3.0 description of a small vehicle lookup and request API. It must be one JSON document, not YAML and not TypeScript. Define exactly two operations: GET /api/vin with operationId decodeVin, which takes a required query parameter vin of type string and returns 200 with a JSON schema that references VinResult; and POST /api/requests with operationId submitRequest, which takes a JSON request body referencing SubmitInput and returns 200 referencing SubmitResult. Put every schema under components.schemas and reference them only with local refs. VinResult has a required boolean found plus optional string make and model. SubmitInput requires string vin, contactName and contactPhone. SubmitResult requires a boolean ok and an integer requestNumber of at least 1. Details are in docs/api-notes.md.
